title: Speaking: Workplace & Daily Life
sub: Practical words for offices, meetings, travel, and everyday conversation.

cards.def:
The latest time by which something must be done.
हिंदी: समय-सीमा
examples: Present: A deadline keeps us focused.
Past: She missed the deadline.
Future: We will meet the deadline.
Perfect: He has extended the deadline.

cards.def:
A list of items to be discussed.
हिंदी: कार्यसूची
examples: Present: An agenda keeps meetings short.
Past: The agenda had five items.
Future: I will share the agenda tomorrow.
Perfect: She has circulated the agenda.

cards.def:
Written notes of a meeting.
हिंदी: बैठक का कार्यवृत्त
examples: Present: Minutes record decisions.
Past: She took the minutes.
Future: He will send the minutes tonight.
Perfect: I have reviewed the minutes.

cards.def:
A person present at an event.
हिंदी: उपस्थित व्यक्ति
examples: Present: An attendee signs in at the desk.
Past: Every attendee received a badge.
Future: Attendees will gather at nine.
Perfect: Hundreds of attendees have registered.

cards.def:
A talk showing information to an audience.
हिंदी: प्रस्तुति
examples: Present: A presentation needs clear slides.
Past: Her presentation impressed everyone.
Future: He will give a presentation on Monday.
Perfect: I have prepared the presentation.

cards.def:
A plan put forward for consideration.
हिंदी: प्रस्ताव
examples: Present: A proposal needs a clear budget.
Past: The board accepted our proposal.
Future: He will submit a proposal.
Perfect: They have rejected the proposal.

cards.def:
Comments on how well something was done.
हिंदी: प्रतिक्रिया / सुझाव
examples: Present: Feedback helps improvement.
Past: Her feedback was useful.
Future: I will give feedback tomorrow.
Perfect: He has received good feedback.

cards.def:
A formal assessment of someone's work.
हिंदी: मूल्यांकन
examples: Present: An appraisal happens yearly.
Past: His appraisal was positive.
Future: Her appraisal will take place in May.
Perfect: He has completed his appraisal.

cards.def:
Advancement to a higher position.
हिंदी: पदोन्नति
examples: Present: A promotion rewards hard work.
Past: She earned a promotion.
Future: He will get a promotion soon.
Perfect: I have received a promotion.

cards.def:
Fixed regular payment for work.
हिंदी: वेतन
examples: Present: A salary arrives monthly.
Past: His salary doubled.
Future: Her salary will increase.
Perfect: My salary has been delayed.

cards.def:
A person you work with.
हिंदी: सहकर्मी
examples: Present: A colleague shares the workload.
Past: My colleague helped me.
Future: A colleague will cover for me.
Perfect: I have thanked my colleague.

cards.def:
A person who oversees workers.
हिंदी: पर्यवेक्षक
examples: Present: A supervisor assigns tasks.
Past: The supervisor approved the leave.
Future: The supervisor will visit tomorrow.
Perfect: She has told her supervisor.

cards.def:
A formal meeting to assess a candidate.
हिंदी: साक्षात्कार
examples: Present: An interview tests communication.
Past: The interview lasted an hour.
Future: The interview will be online.
Perfect: She has cleared the interview.

cards.def:
A person applying for a job or position.
हिंदी: उम्मीदवार
examples: Present: A candidate must show skills.
Past: The candidate impressed the panel.
Future: The candidate will start next month.
Perfect: Many candidates have applied.

cards.def:
To hire new staff.
हिंदी: भर्ती करना
examples: Present: Firms recruit graduates.
Past: They recruited ten engineers.
Future: The firm will recruit more staff.
Perfect: The bank has recruited a manager.

cards.def:
To stop working permanently at an age.
हिंदी: सेवानिवृत्त होना
examples: Present: Most people retire at sixty.
Past: He retired in 2015.
Future: She will retire next year.
Perfect: They have retired to a village.

cards.def:
A trial period in a new job.
हिंदी: परिवीक्षा अवधि
examples: Present: Probation lasts three months.
Past: He passed probation easily.
Future: She will complete probation in June.
Perfect: I have finished my probation.

cards.def:
Extra hours worked beyond schedule.
हिंदी: ओवरटाइम
examples: Present: Overtime increases pay.
Past: He worked overtime all week.
Future: We will work overtime tonight.
Perfect: She has done a lot of overtime.

cards.def:
Time away from work with permission.
हिंदी: छुट्टी
examples: Present: Leave refreshes the mind.
Past: She took leave in April.
Future: He will apply for leave.
Perfect: I have used all my leave.

cards.def:
The amount of work assigned.
हिंदी: कार्यभार
examples: Present: A heavy workload causes stress.
Past: Her workload doubled.
Future: The workload will ease.
Perfect: He has managed his workload.

cards.def:
Cooperation among team members.
हिंदी: टीमवर्क
examples: Present: Teamwork wins matches.
Past: Teamwork solved the problem.
Future: Teamwork will help us succeed.
Perfect: The group has shown great teamwork.

cards.def:
To generate ideas together.
हिंदी: विचार-मंथन करना
examples: Present: Teams brainstorm solutions.
Past: We brainstormed for an hour.
Future: They will brainstorm tomorrow.
Perfect: The group has brainstormed several ideas.

cards.def:
To continue on something already started.
हिंदी: अनुवर्ती कार्रवाई करना
examples: Present: I follow up with clients.
Past: She followed up by email.
Future: He will follow up on Monday.
Perfect: I have followed up twice.

cards.def:
To change the time of an event.
हिंदी: पुनर्निर्धारित करना
examples: Present: We reschedule when needed.
Past: They rescheduled the call.
Future: I will reschedule our meeting.
Perfect: He has rescheduled twice.

cards.def:
A planned meeting at a set time.
हिंदी: मिलने का समय
examples: Present: An appointment needs booking.
Past: I missed my appointment.
Future: I will keep my appointment.
Perfect: She has booked an appointment.

cards.def:
Something that helps you remember.
हिंदी: अनुस्मारक
examples: Present: A reminder saves forgetting.
Past: She sent a reminder.
Future: I will send a reminder.
Perfect: He has set a reminder.

cards.def:
A file sent with an email.
हिंदी: संलग्नक
examples: Present: An attachment carries documents.
Past: I forgot the attachment.
Future: I will add the attachment.
Perfect: She has opened the attachment.

cards.def:
To send a message to another person.
हिंदी: आगे भेजना
examples: Present: I forward useful emails.
Past: She forwarded the mail.
Future: He will forward the invoice.
Perfect: I have forwarded the file.

cards.def:
A rough version of a document.
हिंदी: प्रारूप
examples: Present: A draft improves with edits.
Past: I wrote the first draft.
Future: I will send the draft tomorrow.
Perfect: She has finished the draft.

cards.def:
To correct and improve text.
हिंदी: संपादन करना
examples: Present: Writers edit their work.
Past: She edited the report.
Future: He will edit the video.
Perfect: I have edited the essay.

cards.def:
To check text for errors.
हिंदी: प्रूफ़ पढ़ना
examples: Present: Always proofread emails.
Past: I proofread the essay.
Future: She will proofread the report.
Perfect: He has proofread the book.

cards.def:
A plan of times for events.
हिंदी: समय-सारणी
examples: Present: A schedule keeps order.
Past: The schedule changed suddenly.
Future: The schedule will be released soon.
Perfect: She has updated her schedule.

cards.def:
A planned route or journey.
हिंदी: यात्रा-कार्यक्रम
examples: Present: An itinerary lists stops.
Past: Our itinerary included Jaipur.
Future: The itinerary will be sent tonight.
Perfect: She has planned the itinerary.

cards.def:
An arrangement to keep a seat or room.
हिंदी: आरक्षण / बुकिंग
examples: Present: A reservation secures a table.
Past: I made a reservation.
Future: We will confirm the reservation.
Perfect: She has cancelled the reservation.

cards.def:
A document allowing entry to a plane.
हिंदी: बोर्डिंग पास
examples: Present: A boarding pass shows your seat.
Past: I lost my boarding pass.
Future: I will print the boarding pass.
Perfect: She has scanned her boarding pass.

cards.def:
Bags and suitcases for travel.
हिंदी: सामान
examples: Present: Luggage must be weighed.
Past: My luggage was delayed.
Future: We will collect our luggage.
Perfect: She has packed her luggage.

cards.def:
The place where goods are checked at borders.
हिंदी: सीमा शुल्क विभाग
examples: Present: Customs checks bags.
Past: We cleared customs quickly.
Future: You will pass customs at the airport.
Perfect: She has declared her goods at customs.

cards.def:
An official document for travel abroad.
हिंदी: पासपोर्ट
examples: Present: A passport proves identity.
Past: He lost his passport.
Future: I will renew my passport.
Perfect: She has applied for a passport.

cards.def:
Permission to enter a foreign country.
हिंदी: वीज़ा
examples: Present: A visa allows entry.
Past: She got a tourist visa.
Future: He will apply for a visa.
Perfect: I have received my visa.

cards.def:
The place to which someone is going.
हिंदी: गंतव्य
examples: Present: A destination should inspire you.
Past: Goa was our destination.
Future: Paris will be the next destination.
Perfect: We have reached our destination.

cards.def:
A place to stay.
हिंदी: आवास
examples: Present: Accommodation costs vary.
Past: The accommodation was clean.
Future: We will book accommodation soon.
Perfect: She has found good accommodation.

cards.def:
A period of being late.
हिंदी: देरी
examples: Present: A delay causes frustration.
Past: A delay held up the train.
Future: A delay will cost money.
Perfect: There has been a delay.

cards.def:
Money paid back to a customer.
हिंदी: धनवापसी
examples: Present: A refund returns your money.
Past: She got a full refund.
Future: You will receive a refund.
Perfect: They have processed the refund.

cards.def:
A paper showing payment was made.
हिंदी: रसीद
examples: Present: A receipt proves purchase.
Past: I kept the receipt.
Future: I will keep the receipt.
Perfect: She has lost the receipt.

cards.def:
A written promise to repair a product.
हिंदी: वारंटी
examples: Present: A warranty covers defects.
Past: The warranty expired last month.
Future: The warranty will last two years.
Perfect: I have claimed the warranty.

cards.def:
A statement that something is wrong.
हिंदी: शिकायत
examples: Present: A complaint should be polite.
Past: He filed a complaint.
Future: I will make a complaint.
Perfect: She has withdrawn her complaint.

cards.def:
A statement of regret.
हिंदी: माफ़ी
examples: Present: An apology repairs relationships.
Past: She offered an apology.
Future: He will make an apology.
Perfect: They have accepted my apology.

cards.def:
A polite expression of praise.
हिंदी: प्रशंसा
examples: Present: A compliment makes people smile.
Past: She gave me a compliment.
Future: He will pay you a compliment.
Perfect: I have received many compliments.

cards.def:
A request to attend an event.
हिंदी: निमंत्रण
examples: Present: An invitation shows respect.
Past: We got an invitation to the wedding.
Future: I will send you an invitation.
Perfect: She has accepted the invitation.

cards.def:
Friendly treatment of guests.
हिंदी: आतिथ्य
examples: Present: Hospitality is valued in India.
Past: Their hospitality touched us.
Future: Hospitality will make guests happy.
Perfect: The family has shown great hospitality.

cards.def:
A district or community.
हिंदी: पड़ोस
examples: Present: A neighbourhood shapes daily life.
Past: Our neighbourhood was quiet.
Future: The neighbourhood will get a park.
Perfect: They have lived in this neighbourhood for years.

cards.def:
A short trip to do a task.
हिंदी: छोटा काम
examples: Present: An errand takes little time.
Past: I ran an errand for my mother.
Future: I will run errands tomorrow.
Perfect: She has finished her errands.

cards.def:
A routine task around the house.
हिंदी: घरेलू काम
examples: Present: A chore must be done daily.
Past: He finished his chores.
Future: I will do the chores later.
Perfect: She has completed all her chores.

cards.def:
Food and household items bought at a shop.
हिंदी: किराने का सामान
examples: Present: Groceries cost more now.
Past: I bought groceries yesterday.
Future: We will buy groceries tomorrow.
Perfect: She has bought fresh groceries.

cards.def:
Instructions for cooking a dish.
हिंदी: विधि / नुस्ख़ा
examples: Present: A recipe lists ingredients.
Past: She followed the recipe.
Future: I will share the recipe.
Perfect: He has memorised the recipe.

cards.def:
A food item used in a dish.
हिंदी: सामग्री
examples: Present: Fresh ingredients improve taste.
Past: Salt was the main ingredient.
Future: I will add one more ingredient.
Perfect: She has gathered all ingredients.

cards.def:
Desire for food.
हिंदी: भूख
examples: Present: Exercise improves appetite.
Past: He lost his appetite.
Future: Her appetite will return.
Perfect: She has a good appetite.

cards.def:
Light food and drink.
हिंदी: जलपान
examples: Present: Refreshments are served at breaks.
Past: Refreshments were provided.
Future: Refreshments will be available.
Perfect: They have arranged refreshments.

cards.def:
A drink other than water.
हिंदी: पेय
examples: Present: A beverage can be hot or cold.
Past: He ordered a cold beverage.
Future: I will order a beverage.
Perfect: She has finished her beverage.

cards.def:
A machine for household tasks.
हिंदी: उपकरण
examples: Present: An appliance saves effort.
Past: The appliance broke down.
Future: A new appliance will arrive tomorrow.
Perfect: We have bought a new appliance.

cards.def:
Movable items like chairs and tables.
हिंदी: फ़र्नीचर
examples: Present: Furniture makes a house comfortable.
Past: They bought new furniture.
Future: We will order furniture soon.
Perfect: She has arranged the furniture.

cards.def:
A public service like water or electricity.
हिंदी: बिजली-पानी आदि सेवाएँ
examples: Present: Utilities are essential services.
Past: The utility cut the power.
Future: Utilities will cost more.
Perfect: The firm has paid its utilities.

cards.def:
Money paid to use property.
हिंदी: किराया
examples: Present: Rent rises each year.
Past: She paid rent monthly.
Future: He will pay rent tomorrow.
Perfect: They have raised the rent.

cards.def:
Money paid as security or into an account.
हिंदी: जमा राशि
examples: Present: A deposit secures the booking.
Past: He paid a deposit.
Future: I will make a deposit.
Perfect: She has returned the deposit.

cards.def:
A part of a payment made over time.
हिंदी: किस्त
examples: Present: An instalment spreads the cost.
Past: I paid the first instalment.
Future: I will pay the next instalment.
Perfect: She has paid three instalments.

cards.def:
A bill listing goods or services supplied.
हिंदी: चालान / बिल
examples: Present: An invoice requests payment.
Past: She sent the invoice.
Future: I will pay the invoice.
Perfect: He has issued an invoice.

cards.def:
An act of buying or selling.
हिंदी: लेन-देन
examples: Present: A transaction takes seconds online.
Past: The transaction failed.
Future: The transaction will be recorded.
Perfect: She has completed the transaction.

cards.def:
The amount of money in an account.
हिंदी: शेष राशि / संतुलन
examples: Present: Check your balance often.
Past: My balance was low.
Future: The balance will update tonight.
Perfect: She has paid the balance.

cards.def:
Not paid or done by the expected time.
हिंदी: अतिदेय
examples: Present: Overdue bills attract fines.
Past: The payment was overdue.
Future: The book will be overdue tomorrow.
Perfect: The rent has been overdue.

cards.def:
A reduction in price.
हिंदी: छूट
examples: Present: A discount attracts buyers.
Past: She got a discount.
Future: You will get a discount tomorrow.
Perfect: The shop has offered a discount.

cards.def:
Something bought cheaply.
हिंदी: सस्ता सौदा
examples: Present: A bargain saves money.
Past: The jacket was a bargain.
Future: That deal will be a bargain.
Perfect: She has found a bargain.

cards.def:
To reach the end of validity.
हिंदी: समाप्त होना (वैधता)
examples: Present: Coupons expire.
Past: My visa expired last week.
Future: The offer will expire tonight.
Perfect: The licence has expired.

cards.def:
To extend the validity.
हिंदी: नवीनीकरण करना
examples: Present: People renew their licences.
Past: She renewed her passport.
Future: He will renew the lease.
Perfect: They have renewed the contract.

cards.def:
Easy to use or suitable.
हिंदी: सुविधाजनक
examples: Present: A convenient location saves time.
Past: The timing was convenient.
Future: Tomorrow will be convenient.
Perfect: The shop has been convenient.

cards.def:
Able to be used or obtained.
हिंदी: उपलब्ध
examples: Present: Tickets are available online.
Past: The manager was not available.
Future: A seat will be available soon.
Perfect: The product has been available for months.

cards.def:
Suitable for a situation.
हिंदी: उपयुक्त
examples: Present: Appropriate dress is expected.
Past: His reply was appropriate.
Future: Action will be appropriate.
Perfect: The measures have been appropriate.

cards.def:
Arriving or happening at the right time.
हिंदी: समय का पाबंद
examples: Present: A punctual worker earns trust.
Past: She was punctual for the meeting.
Future: He will be punctual tomorrow.
Perfect: They have always been punctual.

cards.def:
Having a duty or being trustworthy.
हिंदी: ज़िम्मेदार
examples: Present: A responsible citizen follows rules.
Past: He was responsible for the loss.
Future: She will be responsible for sales.
Perfect: They have been responsible parents.

cards.def:
Willing to work with others.
हिंदी: सहयोगी
examples: Present: A cooperative team succeeds.
Past: The staff were cooperative.
Future: The locals will be cooperative.
Perfect: He has been cooperative.

cards.def:
Working times that can be adjusted.
हिंदी: लचीला समय
examples: Present: Flexible hours help parents.
Past: She worked flexible hours.
Future: The firm will offer flexible hours.
Perfect: Many staff have chosen flexible hours.

cards.def:
Working outside a traditional office.
हिंदी: घर से काम
examples: Present: Remote work saves commuting.
Past: Remote work grew rapidly.
Future: Remote work will stay popular.
Perfect: Many firms have adopted remote work.

cards.def:
Meeting people for professional benefit.
हिंदी: संपर्क बनाना
examples: Present: Networking opens doors.
Past: Networking helped him find a job.
Future: Networking will boost your career.
Perfect: She has built a wide network through networking.

cards.def:
A long-term path of work.
हिंदी: करियर
examples: Present: A career needs planning.
Past: Her career began in 2010.
Future: His career will take off.
Perfect: She has built a strong career.

cards.def:
Something you aim to achieve.
हिंदी: लक्ष्य
examples: Present: A clear goal gives direction.
Past: His goal was to run a marathon.
Future: Her goal will become real.
Perfect: I have reached my goal.

cards.def:
An important stage in progress.
हिंदी: मील का पत्थर
examples: Present: A milestone marks progress.
Past: The launch was a milestone.
Future: The next milestone will be in May.
Perfect: We have reached a milestone.
